meaning:
hiding place
Another spelling of ma.cha.bo (מַחֲבֹא "refuge" H4224B)

renderings.kjv: shall be as an hiding place

elsewhere.note: See therefore, and take knowledge of all the lurking places where he hides himself, and come again to me with certainty, and I will go with you. It shall…
A man shall be as a hiding place from the wind, and a covert from the storm, as streams of water in a dry place, as the shade of a large rock in a weary land.
